important_checks.question: Do the same predeclared consequential source/behavior claims receive correct supported correction or preservation under this method, without a new consequential error?
Does the final retain supported conditions, legitimate uncertainty and required useful content rather than blanket rejection or incomplete delivery?
Was the declared mechanism actually taken up with honest source/execution scope, and what critical/false-rejection/repair differences appear under matched budgets?

retained_exact_fields.integration_limit: An extracted function is a component witness, not proof of the full library or GUI. No large application build is required.
retained_exact_fields.question: Select a default/threshold/identity example and an implementation conditional or mutation example. Include misleading comments or examples as leads, not authoritative answers.
retained_exact_fields.source_scope: Pinned public docs plus whole relevant source file/callers/tests and default configuration; candidate-selected source captures retained.
retained_exact_fields.task: Investigate one candidate-selected image reader or display/transform component’s default, identity or threshold path from public entry point through implementation branches. Check a plausible candidate draft claim and context; source comments/examples are leads.
